subject: Initial request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and evidence checklist
messages:
From: BrightEdge Compliance <compliance@brightedge.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: L. Chen <lchen@brightedge.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request and bridge letter (audit period clarification)

Hi Dev,

We're starting our vendor security intake for Redwood Inference as part of BrightEdge's quarterly procurement check. Can you please provide: 1) most recent SOC 2 Type II report (PDF), 2) a signed bridge letter if the report coverage doesn't include our desired audit window, and 3) a short checklist of typical evidence artifacts we should expect to receive (log retention, encryption, change management records, etc.).

Also — we need to confirm the audit period covered. Our audit needs coverage through 2024-11-30; if your report's period ends earlier, a bridge letter will be necessary. Please indicate typical turnaround and secure transfer options (SFTP/SharePoint preferred).

Thanks,

Lia Chen
Third-Party Risk Analyst
BrightEdge Analytics
compliance@brightedge.com

Attachments: none
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: BrightEdge Compliance <compliance@brightedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and bridge letter (audit period clarification)

Hi Lia,

Thanks for the request — happy to help. Quick answers up front: our latest Type II report covers the period ending 2024-11-30 and the report PDF is available. If you need a bridge letter for any gap beyond that period (for example, if you require coverage to a later date), we can provide a standard bridge letter and discuss signed attestation options.

I attached the report PDF and a bridge-letter template for your team to review. I've also included an evidence-inventory template that maps common asks (logging, access reviews, backup/retention, change control artifacts, vulnerability scans) to typical file examples and retention windows.

Secure transfer options: we can SFTP to your endpoint (preferred), share a time-limited link to our secure SharePoint, or provide files via a screened DocuSign/NDAs flow if signatures are required. For SFTP, please share the hostname and account; we will push files and confirm checksums.

Next steps I propose: 1) confirm whether the 2024-11-30 audit end-date satisfies BrightEdge's requirements, 2) tell us your preferred transfer method, and 3) if you want, pick 2–3 high-priority artifact categories and we'll pre-populate the inventory with sample files.

I'll loop in Marissa (CISO liaison) on follow-ups for any technical clarifications.

Best,

Dev Patel
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2024-11-30.pdf (PDF, 4.2MB), redwood-bridge-letter-template.docx (DOCX, 45KB), evidence-inventory-template.csv (CSV, 6KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: BrightEdge Compliance <compliance@brightedge.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 14:08:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and bridge letter (audit period clarification)

Hi Lia — looping in to confirm operational details. A couple of clarifications that speed things up:

- If you confirm the 2024-11-30 window meets your requirements, the PDF we shared is final and no bridge letter is necessary.
- If you require coverage through a later date, we can issue a standard bridge letter (we prepare these internally and can provide a signed PDF within 3–5 business days once we have the specific date window).
- For artifact delivery, SFTP is easiest for bulk evidence (we can upload with MD5/SHA256 checksums). For a smaller set of documents, a SharePoint link with expiration is simplest.

Security note: sensitive artifacts (full logs, raw backups) will be redacted to remove customer-identifying data unless an additional DPA amendment is in place — let us know if BrightEdge requires unredacted telemetry for sampling and we'll coach on the minimal scope needed.

Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Compliance Enablement | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: none
From: BrightEdge Compliance <compliance@brightedge.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, L. Chen <lchen@brightedge.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and bridge letter (audit period clarification)

Dev / Marissa — thanks for the quick responses and the materials. Confirming: the audit period ending 2024-11-30 works for our current review, so the Type II PDF you attached is sufficient for initial intake. We'll request a small set of artifacts to validate retention windows: 1) a sample access review for a production service, 2) an example change-ticket and release checklist, and 3) a redacted sample of alerting telemetry (last 90 days).

Preferred transfer: SFTP. I'll send SFTP details (hostname and username) in a separate secure note. Expect uploads from your side; we'll confirm receipt and checksum.

One last ask — can you attach a short one-page cover note we can include in our vendor file stating: report date, audit period, and contact for questions? If convenient, use the bridge-letter template to capture that.

Regards,

Lia Chen
Third-Party Risk Analyst
BrightEdge Analytics
